text: The subject Omer Yousaf holds account PK**MUCB****9220 which was opened on 19 July 2023. The subject is declared as a Student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. During the activity window from 3 March 2026 to 12 March 2026 the account recorded 29 credits totalling PKR 1,392,000 and 6 debits totalling PKR 1,204,000. All 29 credits arrived via interbank (IBFT) transfers from 24 distinct senders. The activity was flagged by Tazama on 12 March 2026, with the typology MULE-01 scoring 360 against a threshold of 300. Overall, the pattern of many senders, rapid outflow, and activity disproportionate to a Student with PKR 25,000 per month is consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 831,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 4 transactions. PKR 373,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. Screening on 30 March 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
